name: cache-clock
description: Status line countdown until this chat's prompt cache goes cold, a warning before it does, and /keepwarm to keep it warm with a hidden fork

ttlMinutes.title: Cache lifetime (minutes)
ttlMinutes.description: How long the cache lives after the last request: 60 on a Claude subscription, 5 with an API key, or what promptCacheTtl sets.

warnMinutes.title: Warn before cold (minutes)
warnMinutes.description: Show a toast this many minutes before the cache goes cold. 0: no warning.

keepWarmHours.title: Keep warm for (hours)
keepWarmHours.description: How long /keepwarm keeps the cache warm when no time is given. It also stops at your next prompt.
